roadmap.title: Step 1 — Finish the story
roadmap.text: Play the five chapters from Gone Fishing to the final mission. The 12 story trophies pop on their own, and the side quest givers meet you along the way. One warning only: do the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude while you still can — it may be missable. Keep a save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots, no mission replay).

roadmap.title: Step 2 — Side questlines & collecting
roadmap.text: Finish the questlines for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and Cal, plus 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. Sweep up the collectibles that track across the map: card sets, WAiNK scans, meditation spots and vehicle scans. Everything here stays available in free-roam after the story.

roadmap.title: Step 3 — The 100% checklist & challenges
roadmap.text: After the credits the 100% Completion Checklist opens under Progress > Stats. It is forgiving — roughly 60% true completion: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and all 8 bank vaults. Most of it is done while chasing the other trophies.

roadmap.title: Step 4 — Cleanup & the platinum
roadmap.text: Mop up the odd ones out — the UFO easter egg, the two trophies no guide has pinned down yet, and anything left on your checklist. The platinum, Vice Got a Price!, pops with the last trophy you earn.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is no extra task behind it. It needs no multiplayer and no DLC, so one single-player run covers the whole list. Track your progress here; the last trophy you earn will trigger it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first mission of the story, so it unlocks naturally as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. A story trophy — just play through the chapter's missions and it pops when the chapter ends. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. A story trophy — finish the chapter's missions and it unlocks on its own. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. A story trophy — play through the chapter and it pops at the end. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. A story trophy — finish the chapter's missions and it unlocks on its own. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. This is the last story mission; finishing it pops the trophy and opens free-roam plus the 100% Completion Checklist. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. A story trophy — it unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. A story trophy — it unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4. A story trophy — it unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4. A story trophy — it unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. A story trophy — it unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. A story trophy — it unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist, which appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story — progress made during the story already counts. The checklist is forgiving, roughly 60% true completion by PowerPyx's measure: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, and 70 of 80 challenges. Nothing on it is missable, so clean it up in free-roam after the credits.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix categories freely — flying under bridges is the quickest. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going after this pops. Track progress by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race (car, race challenge or drone race) and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities to see which types you have done; most come up naturally while chasing other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The golds are not too hard by PowerPyx's account — work through each range's challenges one by one and use the range locations from the PowerPyx guide. The trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races in total). You only need one win per location, not all 42 races. PowerPyx lists all 14 drone race locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so pick the shortest and easiest courses and win a different one each time. PowerPyx lists all 40 race locations.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him at the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Four video games exist: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Finish all levels of any one game once — you do not need to beat every challenge.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her questline is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3 with a call from Andy, then a text with her address in Belville. Finish her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — all still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His questline opens in Chapter 1, marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento after the mission Island Dreams. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks: follow the purple chest icons, use the metal detector on the ocean floor and bring each find back. He goes quiet during parts of the story but returns in Chapters 2–3. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Finish his five jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — all available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain strangers count — confirmed so far are Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete; other questlines such as Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. All of them remain available in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His Randy's Wish List questline opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you unlock the Key Cloner and deliver him a Zorrusso. He then wants 16 sports cars: scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check the list, steal them and drive them to his garage in west Vice City. Deliveries in good condition pay more.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City — destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, then his second quest Spin On This unlocks the trophy. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, tracked under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: the first meditation happens at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. It is not yet confirmed whether that one is required for the trophy, so do it while you can. The last spot needs both characters playable together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret Vogel texts you about the quest Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons; bring the animals he requests back to him. His first quest gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle. Track the 15 Target Decks under Map > Activities.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; PowerPyx lists 18 card set locations. Finish any 3 full sets — you do not need them all.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold up on the D-pad and R1 to scan things in the world — landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags. There are more than 100 in total, so any 100 count.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 in all and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way. View them under Progress > Challenges; most complete naturally while chasing other trophies, then pick the easiest remaining ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. You need both characters free-roaming together, unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — call your partner with hold-right on the D-pad plus Triangle. Build 4 stars by causing chaos, then escape the red heat zone; a fast sports bike through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia works well. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which forces 4-star escapes.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Bring your partner, then hit 3 robbery targets (green icons) in a row while the police chase continues — keep the flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) are a good run; the trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold up on the D-pad) and scan vehicles as they pass — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. A busy road gives you dozens in minutes. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Aim a firearm and press L3 + R3 to slow time; the focus bar drains fast, so eat or drink to top it up and use Adrenaline to extend it. Line up 5 enemies (gang operation crews work well) and drop them with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal — the one at terminals E3/E4 is easiest, reached by driving through a fence around the airfield. Board it, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off; fly about 1 km from the airport and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. Tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive in through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe-code note, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good pick.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Unlock them with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it with your partner (hand off a bag with hold-right on the D-pad). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more security vans. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this pops on the way. Each vault pays up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults counts — tailing the truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts as robbing the truck. Or find an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, block it, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it, then escape the red heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map. Fly a plane over every black-fogged area until the whole map is visible; a plane is the fastest way to cover the state.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs and 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you get near them. One per gang pops this trophy; the 100% checklist needs all 39. Track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City — you need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — then drive straight out through the showroom window. Only that blue Banshee counts; it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Rob all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation): the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs). It pops after you escape the police. You meet the place during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling; if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can finish the rest then.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Strength rises by working out — buy a fitness club membership and train with both characters together (call your partner with hold-right on the D-pad plus Triangle; while one trains, the other progresses too). You can only switch between both characters after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and watch for the demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Robberies, stealthy objectives, clean escapes, fights and kills all count; it builds up passively while chasing other trophies, and the trophy list shows your count out of 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The official description gives no concrete step, so do not grind anything for it yet — check back once a guide confirms the trigger.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Late at night (after 2AM), go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look for a blinking car at the roadside. If it is there, follow the path into the woods to find the UFO, approach it, then talk to the woman it drops and help her by returning to her car at the roadside. The car does not always spawn — drive away and come back if it is not there.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be earned by kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. The official description gives no concrete step, so treat this as unconfirmed and check back once a guide verifies it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies; bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so a few vault runs cover it.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way there, as they are the priciest. The total counts across every shop type — Ammu-Nations, mod shops, Pay 'n' Sprays, clothing, footwear, hair and beauty, tattoo studios and electronics stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garages (4 more come from the story and do not count). They cost $160,000 in total and go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4, fund them fastest.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses; drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then choose Respray and Register in his garage. You need garage space first (see Little Boxes), and at first he only takes vehicles without trackers — from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the cost down.
